description:
The Impatient Little Snail: Slow and Steady Always Wins! — Sammy the Snail wished he was as fast as a rocket! But what happened when the speedy rabbit tripped on the garden path?
Kids science answer for "patience moral story for children" with fun 2D animation by BabyBeats Rhymo!

Rushing through things leads to tripping, making mistakes, and missing the journey. Taking your time with patience helps you finish strong and notice beauty.

BabyBeats Rhymo creates kid-safe 2D science cartoons and funny educational stories every day for curious US kids and families!
